title: Modifier target
description: A key a modifier's target may name when no other table holds it: a rule's number (crit_window, loot_roll) or a flag (darkvision). Attributes, skills, derived stats, actions, conditions, and damage types are targets from their own tables and are not repeated here. Rules: docs/core/modifier.md#target; gate: docs/core/integrity.md (gate 4).

key.description: The string a modifier's target holds.

kind.description: number: add, mul, and set change it. flag: grant sets it, and its value is ignored.

description.description: What a modifier on this target changes, and in what unit.

pending.description: No golden vector applies a modifier to this target yet, so no implementation is held to a rule for it. validate.py fails the flag when a vector uses the target, and its absence when none does.
